data_description.rate_limit: In seconds. A Bluetooth read that would start sooner than this after the previous read is skipped. This never schedules extra reads.

init.description:
Sensors are updated by reading the BM2 over Bluetooth. A read is triggered when a BM2 advertisement is received (at most once every 10 seconds), or after 60 seconds if no advertisement has triggered one. The rate limit lengthens the minimum time between reads, for example when the BM2 advertises frequently.

It is recommended to select the appropriate battery chemistry as the BM2 by default has some strange definitions of overall status.
init.title: Options
